name: Explore the editorial research journey
description: Verifies the landing page presents the main research journey as an interactive visual panel and exposes a project CTA.
steps: Open the Let’s Research landing page
Select a different research stage in the journey panel
expected: The selected stage changes its image and copy, and the project intake page opens.

name: Navigate the mobile landing page
description: Verifies the primary landing experience remains usable on a phone.
steps: Open the landing page on a mobile viewport
Close the menu and advance the research journey
expected: The menu opens and closes cleanly, and the story panel remains readable and interactive.

name: Open the research workspace
description: Verifies the workspace presents its grouped navigation and core research panels.
steps: Select Projects from the workspace navigation
expected: The dashboard navigation changes the visible module and Overview returns to the project, metrics, activity and research table panels.

name: Start research with required information
description: Verifies the research intake flow prevents an empty submission and accepts a completed brief.
steps: Submit the form without the required project question
Enter the required project information and submit
expected: Validation is shown for the missing required field, then a completed submission reaches the success state.
